title: Tom Gayner VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
Choosing Your Game, and Why I Read War and Peace Aloud 
The Markel CEO on knowing your edge ("I'm not racing Usain Bolt") and the discipline of stick-to-itiveness across decades.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speaker argues that Markel has successfully emerged from a recent fallow period and maintains a long-term record of compounding in the low double-teens over 39 years. He concludes that while short-term races favor pure speed or IQ, long-term investing success depends on will, determination, and proper pacing rather than just athletic skills.
